performance.verdict: Ads are dark 16 days; score is a lagging artefact, not reality.

findings.text: Meta spend reads $0 every day from 2026-08-06 through 2026-08-24 — 19 consecutive zero-spend days. All 27 28-day leads and $659 spend belong to the Jul 28–Aug 5 window only.
GHL shows 27 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — every lead that did arrive went unworked. This is an intake leak, not an ads problem.
The score of 100 and 'green' status are artefacts of the 28-day window masking 19 dark days; the triage signal is materially wrong and should not be trusted this cycle.
GBP is still generating actions (172 over 28d, 58 calls) while paid is dark — organic is the only active lead surface right now, and it is untracked for case conversion.
IG reach spiked to 210–182 on Aug 21–22 from a baseline near 0, while spend was $0 — likely organic reel pickup; worth monitoring but unexplained without platform data.

suggestions.text: Diagnose and restore Meta spend immediately — 19 dark days at $65–75/day SOW budget is a confirmed full stop.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has shown $0 spend every day from Aug 6 through Aug 24 — 19 consecutive dark days against the contracted $65–75/day budget. Check for a payment failure, account flag, campaign pause, or policy hold in Meta Business Suite and resolve before any optimisation is possible. Success is confirmed when daily spend returns to ≥$60 for 3 consecutive days. Escalate to Sohib and Marwan today; this gates all volume targets.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake: 27 contacts, 0 opportunities created — leads are arriving but Andrew's pipeline is empty; repair before ads restart.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL logged 27 contacts over the past 28 days but shows 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — no lead was moved into the pipeline. Audit the GHL workflow with Andrew to confirm whether the instant-form webhook is firing correctly and whether stage-entry automation is active. Success is confirmed when new contacts auto-create opportunities within the same session. This must be resolved before ad spend is restored, or leads will again go unworked.

suggestions.text: Watch IG organic reach spike (210 on Aug 21) — no spend driving it; hold until ad account is live to separate paid vs organic signal.
suggestions.monday_update: Instagram reach jumped to 210 on Aug 21 and 182 on Aug 22 with zero ad spend — this may be organic reel traction. No action is warranted until Meta spend is restored and we can isolate paid vs organic reach in the platform. Re-check on 2026-08-28 after spend is confirmed live; if organic reach holds above 150 alongside paid activity, flag for Hamza to assess a dedicated IG placement test.
